S&P hourly chart – Initial pathing for the week around the key 579.75 level. Keep in mind that earnings kicks off to a strong start Tuesday with AMD moving semiconductors. Earnings gaps and volatility *may* invalidate technical levels. Truly a week to take day by day.

Market internals – Probably lean a bit more bearish than bullish, however... It really doesn't look like new money sellers. Looks more like profit taking, and longs late to the party stopping out. Nothing substantial on any given individual session.
Market profile – Double distribution on the Friday session with PoC shifting to the lower distribution and most of value as well. Stronger buyers would not have let that happen into the close.
